from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Financial statement type, e.g., '合并利润表' or '合并资产负债表'")
    item_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the report")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a string, preserving original format including units")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
